testCase.name: [本地] S13 Existing specs: what reaches the next day without an import (the one-line summary card and yesterday's bedside transcript)

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S13 「现成的 spec：不导入也能带到第二天的东西（一行摘要卡片和昨天的床旁转写）」 Existing specs: what reaches the next day without an import (the one-line summary card and yesterday's bedside transcript)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 Day-2 reopen (Hospital, 20 h): yesterday's encounter and note are gone from the working tabs (18 h). They are still present as yesterday's transcript and, read-only, as the previous note until the wi …（UAT TC-13；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1；TFA-94699 table (Encounter, note)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U12 A one-line summary from today's finished note appears in tomorrow's pre-round with no upload, paste or photo step. It contains nothing the note did not say and appears on that patient only.（UAT TC-13；UAT 3.4；TFA-92591 AC 5；TFA-92591 How it works 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Tim's fixtures: a Hospital patient with note generation and course refresh mocked, and a Hospital patient whose live transcript is dated the previous day (seeded transcriptDate)

When Dictate, Generate Note & Finish, open Pre-Round. On the other patient, start and stop a new bedside recording today, then Generate (mocked)

Then 'Carried Forward from Last Finished Note' shows the generated one-line summary, stored as nextPreRoundSummary, with no import step. Yesterday's lines are archived and listed as '<date> (prior)', today's line is the live transcript, and a same-day write does not archive again

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in encounter-workflow.spec.ts and prior-transcripts.spec.ts; passes only if both pass. This covers the same day and a calendar-day change only. The summary still being there tomorrow, the typed encounter, the 18 h window and the previous note are covered in S12 and S15

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-13.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：测试问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92591 in progress；TFA-94699 in progress

医生这边没问题：Tim 的两个脚本还按旧流程点 Generate、等任务，但 7f3907f 之后按一次 Stop 就自动生成、录音时转写是藏起来的。

Nothing is wrong for the physician: Tim's two specs still press Generate and wait for tasks, but since 7f3907f a single Stop generates the note automatically and the transcript is hidden while recording.

依据：allure 93b5031b, marked 测试过时（本地）. encounter-workflow.spec.ts times out, and prior-transcripts.spec.ts cannot see the live line. Bisected over 7f3907f^, 5d83248^ and 5d83248: no regression. Two physician-visible changes should be confirmed with Tim / Daniela: auto-generate on Stop with the transcript hidden while recording (7f3907f), and no task extraction after Generate (726f724).

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
